CommunityApplications.Profile:
Home of **plungarr** — unclogs your Sonarr/Radarr download pipeline. It watches the arr queues and SABnzbd, auto-fixes stuck imports, removes dead usenet posts that stall the queue at 0 B/s, blocklists junk releases, flags chronically failing episodes, and reports suspicious library files for manual inspection. Anything it can't fix safely, it reports and leaves alone.
Support: https://github.com/stove-bison/plungarr/issues
